remarks: CHARMING 2-BEDROOM APARTMENT FOR RENT! Light, spacious, and conveniently located just minutes from I-95 (Exits 14 & 15), the Merritt Parkway, Matthews Park, Norwalk Hospital, SONO, schools, and all the shops and restaurants along CT Avenue. This well-kept 2nd-floor unit features 2 bedrooms, 1 full bath, a living room, an eat-in kitchen, and a covered deck that provides outdoor living space perfect for relaxing. Convenient off-street parking on side of house for one car. Tenant pays all utilities. Pets will be considered on a case-by-case basis with landlord approval. Garage and basement are for landlord use only. All applicants must complete full RentSpree report.
